Set where one Agent's Messages to another go: `auto` or `drop`. Both must be you or in your Reach; never a Route to yourself, and never over a Route the user set. Agent references accept `me` (you), an exact case-sensitive Rail name, `name:<Rail name>` for collisions, or a canonical id. Owner fields also accept explicit Actors; omitted/null Todo owners remain Unassigned.

Usage: rup route set [OPTIONS] <from> <to> <delivery>

Arguments:
  <from>
          

  <to>
          

  <delivery>

Options:
      --agent <id>
          Act as this Agent; the default is the id in ROUNDUP_AGENT

      --json
          Print the method's result as JSON on stdout

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Example:
  rup route set "..." "..." auto
